text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 251, July 31, 1970 ]
CREATING A PRESIDENTIAL ACTION COMMITTEE ON LAND PROBLEMS
WHEREAS, among the most serious problems that confront the country today are the disputes over land
between small settlers and big land owners;
WHEREAS, it is a basic policy that the government should provide greater protection and assistance to small
settlers, small landholders and members of the cultural minorities;
WHEREAS, land disputes create tension between small settlers, members of the cultural minorities and other
claimants and result in social unrest;
WHEREAS, there is urgent need to coordinate the activities of many different agencies involved in the
implementation of land and forestry laws, as well as agencies attending to the needs of small settlers and
cultural minorities, in order to obtain immediate settlement of land problems and to protect and insure justice
for small settlers and members of minority groups.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, hereby create a Presidential Action Committee on Land Problems (PACLAP) to expedite
and coordinate the investigation and resolution of land disputes, streamline and shorten administrative
procedures, adopt bold and decisive measures to solve land problems, and/or recommend other solutions.
The Committee shall be composed of the following:
Secretary of the Agriculture and Natural Resources
Undersecretary for Natural Resources
Action Officer
Undersecretary for Agriculture
Action Officer
Justice Undersecretary Guillermo Santos
Defense Undersecretary Efren Plana
PANAMIN Chairman Manuel Elizalde, Jr.
PC Chief General Eduardo Garcia
CNI Chairman Datu Mama Sinsuat
SFC Chairman Raoul Beloso
LA Deputy Governor Ernesto Valdez
Agrarian Counsel Felix Diaz
Lands Director Vicente A. Valdellon
Forestry Director Jose Viado
Mines Director Fernando Busuego, Jr.
Fisheries Commissioner Andres Mane
The Committee is hereby authorized to subpoena witnesses; produce records and other documents thru
subpoena duces tecum; and to call for assistance from any Department, Office, Agency or instrumentality of
the National Government, including government-owned or controlled corporations and local government
instrumentalities, in connection with the performance of its functions, and such assistance shall forthwith be
extended whenever the same is sought by the Committee.
Special releases of funds in connection with the Committee’s functions which cannot be funded by regular
appropriations is hereby authorized.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of July, in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
